Welcome, adventurer.
This land holds more than the old stories tell: monsters that steal, cast or grow stronger wave after wave, quests posted on the Notice Board every day, an Arena that never closes and much more.

The Adventurer's Guide will teach you each of them when it becomes part of your journey. When you see the blinking question mark on the right of your screen, click it to read the new lesson.

Every lesson you were given can be read again in the Guidebook: type .guide in the chat, or press Alt+B and choose Adventurer's Guide on the Community Board.
